integrity: Symbolic proof and two independent finite verifiers checked; finite calculations are not substituted for infinite proof; no independent mathematical validation is claimed.
limitations: Exact all-frequency formulas are for the scattered binary pattern 010 (and its complement 101), not arbitrary patterns. The irregular slope coefficients are given by a finite partition formula at each frequency, without a further asymptotic claim. Historical priority remains conditional on accessible literature.
title: Quadratic-gap partition law and sharp stabilization for scattered 010 occurrences
